purpose: Calibrate the user-requested separation of memetic appeal from conceptual value.
user_clarification: something can be memetid without being valuable.
it's vacous, but it is memetic

protocol.policy_change: Only memetic instructions/levels and composition instructions change; version advances to 6. All other axes and target thresholds must compare equal.
protocol.unchanged_v5_reuse: Reuse only exact complete request matches from the prior live experiment. Fresh controls run once per policy. No provider retry or tuning after results.
protocol.input_blinding: Only the state is sent, along with the policy questions; titles, source URLs, expectations, user judgments and previous scores are excluded.
protocol.interpretation: A disagreement with an assistant expectation is unresolved, not automatically a false positive. Human example is an exposed development control, not held-out evidence.
protocol.composition_limit: This is a prose transfer probe. Composition instruction isolation is checked deterministically, not calibrated by a prose composition request.
